name: Stamped Ice
why_visit: Water leases on a red clock. The ice ring crosses the lane on a period, and the Charter sells the minute.

bodies.name: Water Lease
bodies.blurb: The lease world. The stamp is the price of the water.
bodies.legal: Rimward Charter water lease. The minute is sold. The ice is not a claim.
bodies.air: Cold lease air inside the office. Vacuum on the ice.
bodies.face: White stamp iron and melt scars.
bodies.crust: Water ice under a charter plate.
bodies.ruins: The first water nail, still counting.

bodies.name: Clock Ice
bodies.blurb: A moon with an ice ring on a known period.
bodies.legal: The clock moon. The ring crosses the lane. Parking a probe in it is a loss.
bodies.crust: Solid ice. The ring is the cut.
bodies.ruins: A probe that sat through one period.

belt.name: Lease Chips
belt.composition: charter ice chips and stamp foil shaken off the water lease
belt.legal: Charter ice chips. A lease cut, not a free belt.

trash.name: Expired Minutes
trash.origin: Buoys that sold a water minute and were cut loose when the stamp ran out.
trash.legal: Expired minute buoys. The next minute is still for sale.

stream.name: Lease Clock
stream.origin: Ice knocked off Clock Ice when the ring crosses the lane.
stream.legal: A timed ice crossing. It has a period. Do not park a probe in it.

pocket.name: Minute Pocket
pocket.why: The minute is sold here. A core is not a lease.

pdo.duty: Lease clerk over Stamped Ice. Read the water minute. Hail a keel that crowds the office. Guns stay on the slate.

duties: Kite over Stamped Ice. Hold 340 to 460 meters off the clock ring and shoot from the flank. Do not sit in the ice.

haulers.name: Ice Factor
haulers.duty: Ice Factor at Stamped Ice. The minute and the ice are weighed in public. Come alongside and the factor reads the stamp.
